as_told.title: Five to seven known undersea base locations

plain: UAP, the government's term for UFOs, are seen in the ocean more than anywhere else, going in and out of the water in five to seven areas of the world, according to an email from a naval intelligence commander. Tim Gallaudet, a retired Navy admiral and oceanographer, tells Michels he received this email, which says "we see them in the ocean more than elsewhere coming in and out of the ocean." Elsewhere in the same talk he goes further and calls the places "undersea bases possibly," which, if true, would mean something unknown is operating from beneath the sea.
